en.headline: Re-Love Festival shifts to Vintage Revival theme at The Mills this weekend
en.dek: The second weekend of the Re-Love Festival at The Mills in Tsuen Wan opens today with a Vintage Revival programme featuring markets, classic cars and 1960s–1980s style.
body: The Re-Love Festival at The Mills in Tsuen Wan moves into its Vintage Revival phase from 14 to 16 August, focusing on 1960s to 1980s aesthetics, second-hand finds and classic vehicles.

Organisers said the weekend will include a curated vintage market with homeware, antiques and clothing, alongside the Old But Gold second-hand market. A vintage car parade is also scheduled as part of the programme.

The wider Re-Love Festival runs across five weekends with themes of upcycling and circular living. Later weekends will cover Y2K street fashion. The Mills is located at 45 Pak Tin Par Street, Tsuen Wan, reachable via MTR Tsuen Wan Station Exit A1.

zh.headline: 南豐紗廠Re-Love綠續生活節本周末轉入古著文化祭
zh.dek: 荃灣南豐紗廠Re-Love綠續生活節第二周末由今日起以「古著文化祭」為主題，包括市集、老爺車及六十至八十年代風格活動。
body: 荃灣南豐紗廠的Re-Love綠續生活節由8月14至16日進入「古著文化祭」階段，聚焦一九六零至八零年代美學、二手物件及經典車輛。
主辦單位表示，周末將有精選古著市集，涵蓋家品、古董及服飾，並設有「Old But Gold」二手市集。節目亦包括老爺車巡遊。
整個Re-Love綠續生活節橫跨五個周末，主題圍繞升級再造及循環生活，其後周末將轉入Y2K街頭時尚。南豐紗廠位於荃灣白田壩街45號，可乘港鐵荃灣站A1出口前往。
